Variants.Content: The helmsman controls the rudder according to the captain's orders and maintains the course according to the force on the sail, the direction of the waves and the reaction of the hull. An excellent helmsman can feel the subtle changes in the ship's hull in the dark, dense fog or narrow waterways; a slow turn of the helm may cause a collision, mast breakage or a collision with the rocks.
